SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: invented for the acceptance test of pdm-brief. Not real customers.

# Interview notes, food box subscription (synthetic)

- Respondent A (family of four, orders weekly): "I order on Sunday, the box must come before Wednesday. Price matters less than the delivery slot."
- Respondent B (family of two, orders twice a month): "I skip a week when the box has things we do not eat. I would pay more to pick items."
- Respondent C (single, orders rarely): "The box is too big. I stopped after the second order."
- Respondent D (family of five, orders weekly): "I compare the price per kilo with the supermarket every time."
- Respondent E (family of three, orders weekly): "Delivery slot first, then freshness. I have never changed the box content."
